_comment: FPS JSON editor, Positions tab: the positions table and the form of the selected position (the Qt tool's Details dialog and its row combos). Tables are data_table sections.

sections.description: The labelling positions of the document, one row each. Click a row to edit it below; double-click a cell of Name, PDB, Chain, Res or Atom to type; the Show box switches the accessible volume in the 3D tab.

columns.title: Show
columns.description: Whether the position's accessible volume is drawn in the 3D tab and written as visible.

columns.title: Name
columns.description: The label of the position; an empty row is named from its chain and residue (A132).

columns.title: Structure
columns.description: The structure file name (the full path is in the tooltip) or the PDB ID; change it in the form below or with Browse PDB...

columns.title: Res
columns.description: Residue sequence number of the attachment atom.

columns.title: Atom
columns.description: Atom the linker is attached to (CB, CA ...).

columns.title: Dye Preset
columns.description: The dye definition the dimensions were taken from (change it in the form below).

columns.title: Dye Model
columns.description: Accessible-volume model: AV1, AV0, AV3 or ROTAMER (change it in the form below).

columns.title: Color
columns.description: Colour of the accessible volume in the 3D tab (change it in the form below).

columns.title: AV (A^3)
columns.description: Volume of the computed accessible volume; empty until it is computed.

sections.title: Selected position
sections.description: Dye and simulation settings of the selected row (the Qt tool's Details dialog).

sections.title: Structure and attachment
sections.description: Where the linker is attached. The lists come from the structure once it is loaded.

sections.label: Chain
sections.description: Chain of the attachment atom, from the loaded structure.

sections.label: Residue
sections.description: Residue of the attachment atom, from the loaded structure.

sections.label: Atom
sections.description: Attachment atom, from the loaded structure (CB when the residue has one).
The structure of the row.

sections.label: PDB file or ID
sections.description: The structure file of the row, or a four-character PDB ID that is downloaded. Press Enter to load it.

sections.title: Dye
sections.description: The dye of the position.

sections.label: Dye preset
sections.description: A dye definition: sets linker length and width, radii and the model. Custom keeps the values below.

sections.label: Dye model
sections.description: AV1: one dye radius; AV0: a point dye; AV3: three radii; ROTAMER: rotamer library.
Colour of the accessible volume.

sections.label: Color
sections.description: Colour of the accessible volume (the transparency stays as it was).

sections.title: Dye dimensions
sections.description: Size of the dye in angstrom.

sections.label: Linker length
sections.description: Length of the flexible linker.

sections.label: Linker width
sections.description: Width of the linker.

sections.label: Radius 1
sections.description: First dye radius.

sections.label: Radius 2
sections.description: Second dye radius (AV3 only).

sections.label: Radius 3
sections.description: Third dye radius (AV3 only).

sections.title: Simulation
sections.description: How the accessible volume is sampled.

sections.label: Body ID
sections.description: The rigid body the position belongs to (docking).

sections.label: Allowed sphere
sections.description: Radius of the sphere around the attachment point where the dye may clash.

sections.label: Grid resolution
sections.description: Grid spacing of the accessible volume, in angstrom.

sections.label: Anchor atoms
sections.description: Atoms the linker is anchored to, if not the attachment atom.

sections.label: Strip mask
sections.description: Atoms removed before the volume is computed.

sections.title: Advanced
sections.description: Contact volume and chain weighting.

sections.label: Chain weighting
sections.description: Weight the sampled positions by the chain length.

sections.label: Contact thickness
sections.description: Thickness of the contact volume around the surface.

sections.label: Contact trapped
sections.description: Fraction of dyes trapped in the contact volume; -1 = not used.

sections.label: Min sphere volume
sections.description: Smallest accepted fraction of the sphere volume.
